title: Width bound for an OR of clauses
statement: Let $n$ and $w$ be natural numbers, and let $cs$ be a finite list of normal-form AND circuits on $n$ variables. Suppose each circuit in $cs$ is a base clause with pairwise distinct variable indices and has at most $w$ literals. Then the DNF of the OR circuit with children $cs$ has width at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of normal-form AND circuits
Every circuit in $cs$ is a base clause
The variable indices in each clause are pairwise distinct
Each clause has length at most $w$
replaced:
Let $cs$ be a finite list of normal-form AND circuits on $n$ variables, and let $w \in
\bbn$. Suppose every circuit in $cs$ is a base clause — a list of literals whose
variable indices are pairwise distinct — and that each such clause contains at most $w$
literals. Then the DNF obtained from the normal-form OR circuit whose disjuncts are the
circuits in $cs$, by converting each AND-clause into a term, has width at most $w$; that
is, every term in it has at most $w$ literals.
